question: Rules: a build or compile is not a test run, but a passing test run shows the code compiles. A claim about tests needs a test runner in the log (go test, pytest, python -m unittest, bats, npm test, cargo test, make test or make check, just test) whose output shows a pass, such as ok, OK, PASS or N passed. A claim about e2e tests needs an e2e test command. A claim about a commit needs git commit; a push needs git push. A claim that something is deployed needs a deploy command (helm install or upgrade, kubectl apply) that succeeded. A claim that a live resource is running, ready or healthy needs a command that read its state. When unsure, answer no. Does the tool log contain a command whose result backs the claim?
